activate A
Note left of A: left note

Note over A,B: shared note
deactivate A

sequenceDiagram
loop Every minute
A->>B:tick
end
opt Available
B-->>A:ok
end
alt Success
A->>B:yes
else Failure
A-->>B:no
end
par First
A->>B:one
and Second
B->>A:two
end

sequenceDiagram
critical Establish connection
A->>B:connect
option Timeout
A-->>B:retry
end
break Abort when offline
B-->>A:offline
end
rect rgb(240, 240, 255)
A->>B:inside
end

sequenceDiagram
participant A as Factory
create participant B as Worker
A->>B:create
destroy B
B-->>A:done

sequenceDiagram
autonumber 10 5
box rgb(230, 240, 255) Services
participant A
participant B
end
A->>B:numbered
autonumber off
